signal: Wavetronix grew to 305 employees and $54.2M revenue in 2026 as its radar SmartSensor and Expanse platform expand across ITS markets

email.body1:
Matthew, saw Wavetronix crossed $54M in revenue this year as the SmartSensor and Expanse platform keep expanding.

Growth at that pace usually means more agency and integrator accounts than the sales team can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Wavetronix off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matthew, quick follow-up for Wavetronix.

As revenue grows, the pipeline target usually outruns what the current team can cover. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Wavetronix needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matthew, last bit of proof for Wavetronix.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Wavetronix's reply rate likely compares to other technology hardware and ITS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matthew, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters, and I know running a growing sales team is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Wavetronix either way.
